/drama/mKs_de6hegqa3rqrq6vri6guhysdbe.title: Love on a Shoestring (2024)
/drama/mKs_de6hegqa3rqrq6vri6guhysdbe.storyline: In an era of rising prices, JIAN Keke has long understood the importance of saving money. Her life seemed to lack the option of love because dating was undeniably costly. That was until she encountered WANG Haikuò, whose spending was as extravagant as a flowing river. Elly, a gold-digging woman, swore to pursue Haikuò, but Keke believed he was kind. How could she allow him to be in deep water? Thus, she began to sabotage Elly’s plans, only to find herself unexpectedly having a crush on Haikuò. Little did she know, this was part of Haikuò’s scheme, leading her into the trap of love.

/anime/mKs_hek3a7gxbu5ta6nhhjk4xkvwra.title: Hotarubi no Mori e (2011)
/anime/mKs_hek3a7gxbu5ta6nhhjk4xkvwra.storyline: One hot summer day a little girl gets lost in an enchanted forest of the mountain god where spirits reside. A young boy appears before her, but she cannot touch him for fear of making him disappear. And so a wondrous adventure awaits. . .

/movie/mKs_wbgpl45f4sr62x2qexl2kvxge4.title: Gabriel's Inferno (2020)
/movie/mKs_wbgpl45f4sr62x2qexl2kvxge4.storyline: An intriguing and sinful exploration of seduction, forbidden love, and redemption, Gabriel's Inferno is a captivating and wildly passionate tale of one man's escape from his own personal hell as he tries to earn the impossible--forgiveness and love.

/series/mKs_y4tptdnc5mbe7qfs7afd775nha.title: Crystal Lake (2026)
/series/mKs_y4tptdnc5mbe7qfs7afd775nha.storyline: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

/movie/mKs_cylqcrvp4ikuicyxrbc7iabxby.title: The Weight (2026)
/movie/mKs_cylqcrvp4ikuicyxrbc7iabxby.storyline: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.
